title: Combine two elements
detail: Drag two bubbles onto the board and drop one on the other.

title: Craft your first focus
detail: A focus turns matter into magic. Grow something, then give it Light.

title: Cast your first cantrip
detail: Find a school of magic, then combine it with an element.

title: Learn your first spell
detail: Drop a spell on your focus. Learning it costs gold.

title: Reach level 2
detail: Every new discovery earns experience. Keep making things.

title: Find a component for a higher spell
detail: Stronger spells ask for rarer materials.

title: Become a Wizard
detail: A person and a spellbook, brought together.
